name: Battery
description: Battery level and charging state for the bar. Hidden on a machine without a battery.

lowLevel.description: Percent at or below which the level is shown as low

criticalLevel.description: Percent at or below which the level is shown as critical

fontFamily.description: Font family of this item; unset follows the bar

fontSize.description: Text size of this item; unset follows the bar

fontWeight.description: Text weight of this item; unset follows the bar

fontItalic.description: Italic text in this item; unset follows the bar

padding.description: Padding of this item along the bar; unset follows the bar

radius.description: Corner radius of this item's own shapes; unset follows the bar

backgroundRole.description: Theme role of this item's own background; unset draws none

backgroundOpacity.description: Opacity of this item's own background; unset means fully opaque

textRole.description: Theme role of this item's text; unset follows the bar
